# Frontier stockade (ART-SF-2)

Original pixel art, generated by `tools/art/starfall_stockade.py`. Uses ART-SF-1's existing 27-colour Starfall palette, indexed PNGs with binary transparency and no smoothing. Wooden posts and braces have upper-left highlights and lower-right shade; objects use one-pixel arcade ink outlines. Lamp illumination belongs to the engine, not a painted glow.

| File | Size | Footprint | Height |
|---|---|---|---|
| palisade.png | 64×96 atlas; 16×32 pieces | 1×1 tile per piece | 2 tiles |
| gate-open.png / gate-shut.png | 48×48 each | 3×1 tiles | 3 tiles |
| watchtower-lit.png / watchtower-unlit.png | 32×80 each | 2×2 tiles | 5 tiles |

`stockade.json` supplies source rectangles, footprint rectangles in sprite coordinates, connection masks and state files. Match a sprite's footprint rectangle to the world footprint when placing it; its upper pixels are height, not extra collision. Gate posts occupy the outer eight pixels of the bottom sixteen-pixel strip. The open gate leaves a clear 32-pixel passage; the shut state blocks the whole strip. Watchtower collision covers its four visible footing corners. Stakes mark future wall extensions and are decorative, not a closed wall.

The palisade atlas has four columns of sixteen-pixel pieces and three rows of thirty-two pixels. Indices 0–10 are: horizontal run, vertical run, NE/SE/SW/NW corners, east/west/north/south ends, stakes. The last slot is transparent and unused. Connection masks use north 1, east 2, south 4, west 8. Pieces have distinct silhouettes/details so a bend or cap can be identified. Final camera-facing placement belongs to SF2.6.

The watchtower has a shake roof, raised platform, open timber legs, bracing, ladder and lantern. Lit/unlit states change lantern pixels only; the roof, supports, scale and footprint remain identical.

[Contact sheet](../../../../docs/art/starfall/stockade-contact.png) and [native-resolution scene](../../../../docs/art/starfall/stockade-scene-1x.png) show the wall run and corner, open gate, tower and a 16×24 scale person on ART-SF-1 ground. These are asset/layout previews, not screenshots of the integrated game. The scale figure is only a review marker.

From the repository root:

    python tools/art/starfall_stockade.py
    python tools/art/starfall_stockade.py --check

Checks cover palette-only pixels, binary transparency, sizes and footprints, distinct wall pieces, a clear open passage and closed gate, stable geometry across lantern states, and exact regeneration of all PNGs and metadata. No outside assets. Art direction reviews before merge. Game integration and the scrolling-town layout remain SF2.6; saves, mechanics, versions and the shipped preview are unchanged.
